ding.title: Deciphering protein evolution and fitness landscapes with latent space models
ding.state: protein sequence x (one-hot over MSA columns)
ding.rep: z = phi(x): VAE encoder q_phi(z|x), 2-D latent
ding.fitness_surface: J(z) = Gaussian-process regression f(z) with RBF kernel over latent z; predicts scalar fitness/stability (T50)
ding.transition: mutations move x, hence z; adaptive walk = motion on J(z)
ding.validation: T50 stability prediction, 10-fold CV, Pearson 0.80±0.06 on 2-D latent

fard.title: Modeling the Attractor Landscape of Disease Progression: a Network-Based Approach
fard.rep: Hopfield weight matrix W = PCC(i,j), w_ii=0 (correlation network)
fard.objective_model: Lyapunov energy E[P] = -1/2 P W P^T
fard.fitness_surface: E over states; attractors = local minima; landscape visualized by interpolating E over first 2 PCs
fard.validation: Parkinson's, glioma, colorectal cancer; attractor basin size/robustness; cancer attractor wider than normal
